name: preserve-uncertainty-in-summaries
description: A researcher asks agents to preserve uncertainty when summarizing incomplete sources.

judgment.statement: Separate supported findings from inference and retain material uncertainty in the summary.
judgment.rationale: A concise summary can turn a tentative observation into a false fact that later work repeats.

limits: Do not invent certainty, sources or claims of independent verification.
This is guidance for interpreting sources; a receipt does not check whether the final prose follows it.

evidence.summary: Explicit synthetic guidance; not a measured task outcome.
